description: Reads a domain's BIMI record (default._bimi.<domain> TXT): whether it is published, the SVG logo URL (l=) and the certificate URL (a=, a VMC or CMC for mailbox providers). Checks the v=BIMI1 tag and that the URLs are https. It does not download the logo or validate the certificate. Choose this tool for: Reads a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published. Close alternatives on this server: security_dnssec_validator (DNSSEC check for a domain: whether a DS record exists); security_cert_revocation_crl (For a domain's current certificate: reads its CRL). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_bimi_record_audit
title: Reads a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published
